typography.instructions: Import 'Barlow Condensed' (Weights: 400, 700, 900) and 'JetBrains Mono' from Google Fonts. Use Barlow Condensed for ALL headings to achieve the 'HUD/Tactical' look. Use JetBrains Mono for ALL numerical data, coordinates, and weather metrics.

usage_rules.primary: Use sparingly for CTAs, active states, and 'Trophy' highlights.
usage_rules.secondary: Use for 'Safe Zones', 'Success' metrics, and map vegetation data.
usage_rules.destructive: Use for 'No-Go Zones', 'Danger' alerts, and critical errors.
usage_rules.background: NEVER use pure black (#000000) for cards. Use #121212 or glassmorphism.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-sm shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(245,166,35,0.2)] transition-all duration-300 hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(245,166,35,0.4)]
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary/10 text-secondary border border-secondary/20 hover:bg-secondary/20 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide rounded-sm

cards.default: bg-card border border-border/50 rounded-md shadow-lg overflow-hidden relative group

inputs.default: bg-input/50 border-input focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary rounded-sm font-mono text-sm

icons.custom_svgs: Use for specific animal tracks or weapon types if Lucide is insufficient.

accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure all text on dark backgrounds is at least #A3A3A3 or lighter. Avoid dark grey on black.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44px for all mobile interactive elements.

universal_guidelines: DO NOT use gradients for backgrounds unless it is a subtle 'spotlight' effect.
DO NOT use rounded-xl or rounded-2xl. Keep it sharp (rounded-sm or rounded-md) for the 'Tactical' feel.
ALWAYS use 'Barlow Condensed' for headings. It is the signature of the BIONIC brand.
Ensure the map interface feels like a 'Command Center' - controls should float over the map with glassmorphism.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for all coordinates, weather data, and ballistics info.
Preserve the 'Dany Lavoie' zone style: Thick borders (4px), no shadow, semi-transparent fill.
